title: Smells like funeral flowers.
text:
Smells like funeral flowers.. About this item: Poo~Pourri Before-You-Go Toilet Spray 2 Fl Oz Black Pepper Leather. Swagger never smelled so good! An alluring blend of wood, citrus and herbal notes that liberates the senses. LIES. Swagger, I think they mean stagger. It did libereate my senses. They tried to run the hell away. I couldn't see, it was hard to breathe and for some God awful reason I could TASTE IT. It was not alluring unless you have deep, deep seated problems.

This smells like great, great great Aunt Ethels funeral that was laid in her parlor in the dog days of August pre ac. It is a cloying stench. I was expexting a nice smell of leather with a bit of a pepper kick. I got old perfum bottles that shattered and were baked in and the smell won't go away. This was just because I opened it to smell and a drop got on the package. It will gag you strong. If you have bowl movements that you need this scent to cover up you need a Dr asap.

I really don't know how they confused this as smelling anything other than flea market Avon bottle floral. It smells like the old rose scented bath crap we all gave grandma in the 80's.

I love the original scent. I give these away for baby showers to use in diaper pails etc. They help keep trash cans smelling great. However the only one I have ever actually enjoyed is the Original. The others I had tried were not this bad but this one broke me. Good luck to anyone who uses this, you will need it. Or maybe get your sinuses fixed. I will still by PooPourri but I hhink they need new sniffers over there, stick to the original scent its a light fresh and won't make you want to move. And as I said it is excellent shower gift!

Made in the good ole USA; up to 100 uses in the 2 oz bottle.
Why spray chemicals when you can spritz botanicals? Unique all-natural essential oils formula helps your home beyond the bathroom — use it to combat strong laundry, nursery and trash bin odors.
